why: A stuck door gives way to bodily force from the shoulder.
Long earlier practice shows as a result at its own time.
Unseen and untouched, something completed itself in the dark and sprouted.
Each side gives the other something, an uncounted exchange.
You give up credit knowingly to keep to what is right.
A stop just before the rushed move is made.
Small acts done long before add up to a result in time.
A handed-down thing carried on with one own change.
Shared joy arrives in the middle of a task.
A small one is given room to try rather than being forced.
A sharp sensation stops the step before the danger is reached.
It bends under strain and does not break.
A thing carried from home to home and kept.
Shared laughter in the middle of a failed dinner.
Fragile new growth begins after being given time and room.
A sharp signal halts a step already begun at the edge.
Grass bends flat under the wind and stands again unbroken.
The present follows the course inherited from what came before.
A shared lightening across the whole street at once.
Care for new life, giving of herself to shelter it.
A spoken name arrives and changes the room.
Endures the strain by yielding pace without giving up.
After the turn from night to morning the same thing reads differently.
An outside force breaks the plan for everyone at once.
Two move in a common rhythm neither imposed.
Speaking the thing aloud changes what it means.
A closed container whose content exists but is not yet known.
Things literally fall into place and one sees where one stands.
An uninvited outside force cuts things off and shows what is lost.
Two progress only by timing their moves to each other.
A single sound arrives and turns everyone attention.
Something exists with content not yet heard or named.
A turn after which the same things face the opposite way.
Literal hail from outside flattens what stood.
Two move together keeping a constant common pace.
A road made simply by people walking it.
A hidden mover whose trail disappears into water.
An empty page where nothing has been written yet.
Scarcity forces the choice of what is truly needed.
You learn about yourself through another person echoing you.
The rhythm of the road carries you past where you meant to go.
A guarded opening that looks out without letting in.
An unmarked surface with nothing yet placed on it.
Not enough for both; constraint presses a decision.
You see an unnoticed trait of your own mirrored by a friend.
A rhythm found only by walking on.
A guard that shuts out most but lets a chosen few through.
An untouched surface with no mark on it yet.
The rock stands between the tree and the threat, and constraint limits growth.
Your own face seen among other people in a reflection.
A small light reveals something that was there all along.
One always keeps watch while the others feed.
A valued thing kept unused, never put to its purpose.
Moving water stopped and held as it is.
The body senses and acts before the reason can be explained.
A light shows a flaw that was always there.
Clearing lets you see where you stand.
What was left standing unused has lost its strength.
Rising movement is halted and held under ice, visible in stillness.
Something is sensed before it can be named.
A small flame reveals only what lies close.
The sun simply shines and everything shows its place.
What stops flowing spoils while what moves stays good.
A moving drop stopped and held just before falling.
A movement under the surface is felt before it is seen.
Giving and receiving between people, uncounted.
Sunlight shows everything, even more than is comfortable.
Resistance gives way to bodily grip strength.
Movement stops and is held while all around goes on.
Covered and left alone, it completes itself within.
A loan returned with an uncounted gift on top.
You alone put your name to it and carry the cost.
Raw bodily force thrown against resistance, repeatedly.
What was planted long ago now yields its result.
Healing completes inside, closed off and invisible.
A small uncounted attention given from one person to another.
Keeping to the truth and knowingly paying the price.
